description:
Macro Deck transforms your phone, tablet, or any device equipped with a modern internet browser into an efficient remote macro pad. With this tool, you can execute single or multi-step actions seamlessly with just a single tap.


What's Changed
🐞 Bug Fixes
- Fix math filters failing on Text variables in templates by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1818
- Keep Store icon packs Store-owned after a backup restore by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1822
- Start locked instead of hanging when the Linux keyring is locked by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1821
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/compare/v3.0.4...v3.0.5
